passage: The Riverside Science Museum opened in 1998. In 2016 it extended its Friday opening hours by two hours. Its east wing renovation was finished in 2020. Visitors can enter permanent exhibitions without paying, but special exhibitions require a ticket.
statement: The museum first opened before the year 2000.
explanation: 1998 年早於 2000 年；before the year 2000 是 opened in 1998 的改寫。

passage: The Riverside Science Museum opened in 1998. In 2016 it extended its Friday opening hours by two hours. Its east wing renovation was finished in 2020. Visitors can enter permanent exhibitions without paying, but special exhibitions require a ticket.
statement: The museum shortened its opening hours on Fridays in 2016.
evidence: extended its Friday opening hours by two hours
explanation: 原文說延長（extended），題目卻說縮短（shortened），與原文明確矛盾。

passage: The Riverside Science Museum opened in 1998. In 2016 it extended its Friday opening hours by two hours. Its east wing renovation was finished in 2020. Visitors can enter permanent exhibitions without paying, but special exhibitions require a ticket.
statement: The museum closed its east wing to the public while it was renovated.
evidence: Its east wing renovation was finished in 2020.
explanation: 原文只說東翼整修完成的時間，並沒有說整修期間是否對外關閉。不能靠常識猜測。

passage: The Riverside Science Museum opened in 1998. In 2016 it extended its Friday opening hours by two hours. Its east wing renovation was finished in 2020. Visitors can enter permanent exhibitions without paying, but special exhibitions require a ticket.
statement: Visitors must pay to see the museum's permanent exhibitions.
evidence: Visitors can enter permanent exhibitions without paying
explanation: 原文說常設展免費；題目說必須付費，彼此矛盾。

passage: A university team invited 120 adults to study a vocabulary app for eight weeks. The participants took the same vocabulary test at the beginning and end of the study. The group's average score increased by 12 percent. The researchers did not measure speaking fluency. All participants used the same version of the app.
statement: Every participant increased their vocabulary score by exactly 12 percent.
evidence: The group's average score increased by 12 percent.
explanation: 整體平均提高 12%，不能推論每個人都剛好提高 12%；文章沒提供個別成績。

passage: A university team invited 120 adults to study a vocabulary app for eight weeks. The participants took the same vocabulary test at the beginning and end of the study. The group's average score increased by 12 percent. The researchers did not measure speaking fluency. All participants used the same version of the app.
statement: All participants used an identical version of the application.
evidence: All participants used the same version of the app.
explanation: identical version 與 the same version 同義，內容一致。

passage: A university team invited 120 adults to study a vocabulary app for eight weeks. The participants took the same vocabulary test at the beginning and end of the study. The group's average score increased by 12 percent. The researchers did not measure speaking fluency. All participants used the same version of the app.
statement: The research team assessed participants' speaking fluency.
evidence: The researchers did not measure speaking fluency.
explanation: 原文明確說沒有測量口語流暢度，題目卻說有評估。

passage: A university team invited 120 adults to study a vocabulary app for eight weeks. The participants took the same vocabulary test at the beginning and end of the study. The group's average score increased by 12 percent. The researchers did not measure speaking fluency. All participants used the same version of the app.
statement: The university team developed the vocabulary app itself.
evidence: A university team invited 120 adults to study a vocabulary app for eight weeks.
explanation: 研究團隊使用 app 進行研究，不代表 app 一定由研究團隊開發；文章沒有說明開發者。
